authorization: Build a Governed Mission Agent 0.6.8 to 0.7.2 Upgrade Bridge

legacyManifestV1Authority.custodyDispositionStatement: No matching private key was recovered after the authorized local custody investigation; the key is valid only for historical 0.6.8 verification and cannot authorize a new release.

replacementAuthority.reason: Mission Agent 0.6.8 embeds only the legacy Ed25519 public key and verifies only the Manifest v1 canonical field set.

requiredChain: Mission Agent 0.6.8 verifies a newly signed Manifest v1 bridge envelope
The exact bridge independently verifies Release Authority v2 and Manifest v3
The bridge installs the exact signed Mission Agent 0.7.2 artifact
securityProof.failedLink: A new Manifest v1 bridge envelope cannot be signed by the only key Mission Agent 0.6.8 trusts.
securityProof.existing068SignatureReason: Ed25519 signatures bind the exact canonical Manifest v1 bytes for the historical 0.6.8 release and cannot authenticate a different bridge envelope.
securityProof.replacementKmsSignatureReason: The replacement KMS public key is absent from Mission Agent 0.6.8 and a replacement key cannot self-authorize.

blockingFinding.finding: The exact private signing authority required to authenticate a new one-time bridge to Mission Agent 0.6.8 is unavailable and formally barred from future signing.
blockingFinding.authorizationStopRule: Phase 4 requires stopping if production Manifest v1 signing is unavailable rather than creating a replacement trust path.
blockingFinding.impact: No bridge artifact or bridge envelope can be created that the unmodified production Mission Agent 0.6.8 will authenticate under the required security model.
safeResolutionOptions: Recover the exact legacy private key under a separately authorized custody process and reverse the formal presumed-unrecoverable disposition only with new evidence and human approval.

Authorize a different application-mediated trust-bootstrap architecture that does not claim to be authenticated by the unavailable Manifest v1 authority and receives a fresh independent security review.

implementation.reason: Implementation stopped at the mandatory legacy signing-authority prerequisite before any bridge design could become an unauthenticated alternate release channel.

independentReview.conclusion: The authorized bridge is impossible under the stated security model while the legacy private key remains unavailable. No safe in-scope alternative exists without introducing a separately authorized replacement trust architecture.

nextAuthorizationRequired: A human trust-architecture decision is required. Either authorize a new evidence-based custody recovery of the exact legacy key, or authorize design of an application-mediated bootstrap that explicitly replaces—rather than purports to use—the unavailable Manifest v1 signing authority.
